mapper.sql: SELECT CONVERT('CONFIRMATION' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS source_type, cr.id AS source_id, cr.student_id, CONVERT(cr.company_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS company_name, CONVERT(cr.position_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS position_name, cr.create_time AS record_submitted_at, CONVERT(CASE WHEN cr.recall_status = 2 THEN 'WITHDRAWN' WHEN cr.status = 2 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN cr.status = 0 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE COALESCE(p.status, 'CONFIRMED') END USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS business_status, CONVERT('COMPANY' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS review_target FROM internship_confirmation_record cr LEFT JOIN internship_stage_assignment p ON p.id = ( SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM internship_stage_assignment p2 WHERE p2.confirmation_record_id = cr.id ) WHERE (cr.recall_status IS NOT NULL OR cr.status IN (1, 2)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM internship_stage_assignment sp WHERE sp.confirmation_record_id = cr.id AND sp.source_type = 'SELF_PRACTICE' ) UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT('SELF_PRACTICE' USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, a.id, a.student_id, CONVERT(a.company USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CONVERT(a.position_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, COALESCE(a.apply_time, a.create_time), CONVERT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'withdrawn' THEN 'WITHDRAWN' WHEN a.status = 'rejected' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN a.status = 'pending' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE COALESCE(p.status, 'CONFIRMED') END USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, CONVERT(a.review_target USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci FROM student_application a LEFT JOIN internship_stage_assignment p ON p.id = ( SELECT MAX(p2.id) FROM internship_stage_assignment p2 WHERE p2.source_type = 'SELF_PRACTICE' AND p2.source_assignment_id = a.id ) WHERE a.application_type = 'selfPractice'

FROM () r INNER JOIN student_users su ON su.id = r.student_id LEFT JOIN `class` c ON c.id = su.class_id LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id LEFT JOIN internship_agreement_submission v ON v.id = ( SELECT av.id FROM internship_agreement_submission av WHERE av.source_type = r.source_type COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND av.source_id = r.source_id ORDER BY av.version DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.*, su.student_user_id AS student_number, su.name AS student_name, su.class_id, c.name AS class_name, m.name AS major_name, CASE WHEN v.id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_SUBMITTED' ELSE 'SUBMITTED' END AS submission_status, COALESCE(v.version, 0) AS version, v.submitted_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_agreement_file af WHERE af.submission_id = v.id) AS file_count
ORDER BY r.record_submitted_at DESC, r.source_type, r.source_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT af.id, r.source_type, r.source_id, c.name AS class_name, su.student_user_id AS student_number, su.name AS student_name, v.company_name, v.version, fu.file_name, fu.file_path
INNER JOIN internship_agreement_file af ON af.submission_id = v.id INNER JOIN file_upload fu ON fu.id = af.file_upload_id
ORDER BY c.name, su.student_user_id, r.source_type, r.source_id, af.sort_order, af.id
SELECT * FROM internship_agreement_submission WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT * FROM internship_agreement_submission WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY version DESC FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: af.id, fu.id AS upload_id, fu.file_name, fu.file_type, fu.file_size, fu.upload_time, fu.file_path, v.student_id, v.source_type, v.source_id
FROM internship_agreement_file af INNER JOIN internship_agreement_submission v ON v.id = af.submission_id INNER JOIN file_upload fu ON fu.id = af.file_upload_id
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE af.submission_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY af.sort_order, af.id
SELECT * FROM file_upload WHERE id = #{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM student_users WHERE id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO internship_agreement_submission (student_id, source_type, source_id, version, company_name, position_name, submitted_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{version}, #{companyName}, #{positionName}, NOW())
INSERT INTO internship_agreement_file (submission_id, file_upload_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{uploadId}, #{sortOrder})
